universe: All current SEC US-exchange inventory rows plus previously stored and collection-observed tickers, including unknown/inactive instruments. Unknown common-equity identity is excluded with a retained reason; CIK identifies issuer, not share class.
discoverySource: Existing SEC exchange inventory, stored issuer facts, collection items and dated SEC financial filing notices. No additional provider or request budget.
featureKnowledgeRule: Freeze values, source IDs/URLs, filing dates and actual DB updated_at/receipt times before decision time. Reproduce exclusively from frozen inputs.
signalTimestampRule: Decision freeze time after all required inputs are known. Ineligible rows have no signal; retain the same freeze-time control reference.
earliestExecutableRule: Strictly later than decision time, in the next/current verified NYSE regular session; no pre-publication or same-quote fills.
entryPriceRule: First stored positive USD Yahoo regular-session quote strictly after the frozen reference, captured within 20 minutes of market time, during the next three eligible sessions. Ineligible names use identical control observation rules, never orders.

benchmarkAssignmentRule.unknown: unassigned; do not substitute a convenient benchmark
benchmarkAssignmentRule.basis: Frozen <=30-day USD market-cap observation, no later reclassification
benchmarkAssignmentRule.limitation: Predeclared size proxies; sector/style residual effects remain

costAssumptions.status: unvalidated fixed-friction study assumption; spread/impact unknown, not executable portfolio profit

corporateActionStatus: unverified; no verified comparable return or profit credited until independently resolved
outcomePriceRule: First fresh observed quote on the exact Nth trading session after entry; never replace a missing target-session price with a later winner. Pair benchmark entry and exit within five minutes. Missing entry/benchmark/target/identity stays in the denominator.
calendar: Existing NYSE 2026-2028 holidays, early closes and America/New_York DST. Outside supported years unavailable.
eligibilityRules: Newly received official SEC 10-Q/10-K/20-F/40-F filing during this collection, linked by CIK and SEC Archives URL
Filed date not in the future; actual receipt is the conservative publication boundary when only a date is supplied
Event is financial_report_filed; direction/materiality are unknown, not assumed bullish
Secondary article/headline extraction is not primary-source confirmation and cannot qualify this v1
rankingRule: Newest eligible SEC receipt first, ticker then issuer CIK; all eligible ranks retained, top six display only
